newPrimaryTextEvidence.source: Montross and Canzona, U.S. Marine Operations in Korea 1950-1953, Vol II, HQ USMC, 1955
newPrimaryTextEvidence.provenance: Accessible transcription of the USMC-authored official history. Existing image-map inspection is preserved; only text concerning the new control-gate question was read.

passages.summary: 15일 밤 제1해병연대는 O-1의 중요 부분과 개별 목표를 확보했다. 전체 인천 도시와 동일한 확보 범위라는 근거는 아니다.
16일 새벽 제5해병연대 진격 명령은 도심 소탕을 한국 해병대에 맡겼다. 같은 날 07시 관찰은 북한군의 야간 철수를 설명한다. 15일의 임의 시점에 도시 전체가 파란색이어야 한다고 단정할 수 없다.
16일 O-3 진출과 FBHL 공격 명령은 구분된다. 2/5는 그날 밤 도로와 FBHL 교차점 약 3,000야드 전에서 멈췄다. FBHL 전체를 그날 확보 경계로 채색할 수 없다.

beachUnitCorrection.basis: Previously inspected official maps pages 89, 109, 119; no repeat image inspection.

gateCorrections.existingObservation: 15Sep exact native fill places source city dot and modern Incheon reference point in red
gateCorrections.invalidInference: Any 15Sep Incheon city point must be blue, so the source is historically wrong
gateCorrections.replacementInterpretation: The date lacks intra-day time, city-point meaning and historic extent. A date-only landing frame cannot by itself prove whole-city ownership. Reclassify the expectation as historically under-specified, not source-history FAIL.
gateCorrections.stillOpen: Whether blue geometry represents the actual landing area at the source's strategic scale; existing 4.45km source-dot and 13.68km modern-reference distances remain evidence, not erased failures.

gateCorrections.existingObservation: Modern Wolmi-do references are outside coarse source coast and far from native blue
gateCorrections.replacementInterpretation: The island's omission or misplaced control needs a separate scale, shoreline-era and registration assessment. Modern reclaimed geography is not a measured 1950 Green Beach outline.
gateCorrections.prohibitedRepair: Move control to force modern anchors, invent a blue island outline, or infer a circular UNKNOWN ownership polygon.

gateCorrections.existingRequirement: Complete dated 15Sep mainland bridgehead is mandatory before any 20-second timeline can be prepared
gateCorrections.replacementInterpretation: This is one possible implementation requirement, not an explicit user requirement. A truthful 15Sep landing event plus qualified partial control/unknown coverage, followed by separately qualified 16Sep-or-later territorial expansion, can satisfy the requested historical progression.
gateCorrections.limits: Must retain visible territorial change overall, use actual source-supported boundaries, never relabel a later state as 15Sep, and never infer red ownership from missing blue coverage.

sourceTypingPolicy.dateMeaning: Source-labeled dated historical summary, not daily measured GIS
sourceTypingPolicy.nativeMorphMeaning: Source-authored visual transition, not independently observed intervening daily front
sourceTypingPolicy.strictRasterKnownCRSRule: NOT_APPLICABLE_BY_DEFAULT; maintain separate measured vector registration policy
sourceTypingPolicy.acceptableConditionalPresentation: Source-bound strategic approximate territories with explicit uncertainty and source dates, at a map scale supported by the registration evidence
sourceTypingPolicy.notAnEscapeHatch: An approximation label cannot excuse a known material location, chronology or ownership contradiction. No detailed beach/city polygon claim without matching evidence.

minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.PART01: Source-supported North Korean southward expansion and Naktong defense; conclude with 15Sep landing event and only separately qualified control evidence.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.PART02: Continue from the identical landing/time boundary into qualified post-landing expansion, then source-supported Seoul recovery.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.boundaryContinuity: Reuse the same source state, camera and labels across the split; no undocumented geographic morph or time reversal.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.15SepState: May be event plus supported island/local front rather than mandatory complete mainland partition. Omitted control must be unclaimed, not automatically enemy-owned.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.16SepState: Use a dated qualified source state or actual achieved tactical segments; do not fill the complete planned FBHL from p137.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.unknownHandling: Retain documented evidence footprint or omit unsupported ownership claims. Do not draw invented unknown circles or close partial lines to fabricate a territorial mask.
minimalTruthfulTimelineOption.Seoul: Preserve 28Sep date semantics; correct approximation locality against exact native source; never borrow 30Sep shape under a 28Sep label.

Resolve exact curve/registered topology defects independently of the historical city-point expectation
If tactical inset is used, independently register historic shore and actual unit-front evidence; planned objectives are not achieved control
Verify runtime makes no unobserved complement-owner inference and distinguishes source dates from visual morph time
Only after source qualification, run the new changed-scope CPU pixel validation and proceed to build preparation
